title.en: Invalid message signature

description.en: The Ed25519 signature in the Authorization header is invalid or cannot be verified against the sender's public key in the ION registry.

resolution.en: Verify that you are signing with the private key matching the public key registered for your subscriber_id. Check that the signing string construction follows the ION spec.

title.en: Sender not registered on ION

description.en: The bap_id or bpp_id in the message context is not found in the ION participant registry.

resolution.en: Ensure your subscriber_id is registered and active on the ION registry. Contact ION network operations if you believe registration is complete.

title.en: Message TTL expired

description.en: The message timestamp plus TTL has elapsed before the message was processed. Maximum TTL is PT30S for most actions.

resolution.en: Ensure your clock is synchronized (NTP). Reduce processing time before sending. Do not reuse messageIds from expired messages.

title.en: Duplicate messageId

description.en: A message with this messageId has already been processed within the idempotency window (30 minutes).

resolution.en: Generate a new UUID for each unique message. Never reuse messageIds.

title.en: Invalid domain code

description.en: The domain in context does not match an ION-registered sector domain code.

resolution.en: Use ion:trade for Trade sector. Other valid domains will be listed in the ION registry.

title.en: Catalog payload exceeds size limit

description.en: The catalog payload exceeds the 10MB limit for a single publish_catalog call.

resolution.en: Split catalog into multiple publish_catalog calls by category or provider location. Maximum 10MB per call.

title.en: Seller KYC expired or suspended

description.en: Provider attempting catalog publish or transaction has kycStatus of EXPIRED, SUSPENDED, or REJECTED. Catalog publish and new transactions blocked until KYC is renewed/restored.

resolution.en: Provider must complete KYC renewal. New transactions blocked until kycStatus is APPROVED.

title.en: Listing suspended — counterfeit flag under investigation

description.en: Resource has an active COUNTERFEIT_FLAG raise ticket. Auto-delist applied pending ION Central arbitration. New transactions blocked.

resolution.en: Wait for arbitration resolution. Provider may respond to raise ticket with evidence.

title.en: Category license missing or expired

description.en: Provider operating in regulated category (pharmacy, alcohol, tobacco, meat) does not have valid categoryLicenses entry for the required license type.

resolution.en: Upload current license certificate with validUntil in future. Renew via relevant authority (BPOM, Kemendag).

title.en: Resource not found in catalog

description.en: The resourceId in the select payload does not exist in the current published catalog for this provider.

resolution.en: Refresh catalog from /on_discover before sending /select. Do not cache resource IDs beyond catalog TTL.

title.en: Resource not available

description.en: The resource has availability.status of OUT_OF_STOCK or DISCONTINUED at the time of select.

resolution.en: Refresh catalog and display current availability status to consumer. Do not allow select on OUT_OF_STOCK or DISCONTINUED items.

title.id: Kuantitas melebihi batas maksimum per pesanan
title.en: Quantity exceeds maxOrderQty

description.en: The quantity requested in select exceeds the maxOrderQty declared in the resource availability.

resolution.en: Respect maxOrderQty from the availability signal. Display this limit to the consumer before checkout.

title.id: Metode pembayaran tidak tersedia untuk produk ini
title.en: Payment method not available for this product

description.en: The selected payment method is not eligible for this offer. e.g. COD not available (paymentConstraints.codAvailable=false) or BNPL not in paymentMethodEligibility.

resolution.en: Check paymentConstraints.codAvailable and paymentMethodEligibility from the offer before presenting payment options to consumer.

title.en: Item reservation window expired

description.en: The on_select quote and stock reservation has expired. BAP sent /confirm after the BPP's declared reservationWindowSeconds elapsed.

resolution.en: Restart transaction from /select. Stock and pricing must be re-quoted.

title.en: Item sold out during transaction

description.en: Between on_select and confirm, another transaction exhausted the available stock. Race-condition loser case.

resolution.en: Display out-of-stock message to consumer. Offer alternative products.

title.en: COD not eligible for this buyer

description.en: Offer supports COD (paymentConstraints.codAvailable=true) but the specific buyer has been declined COD — new buyer, previous COD failure, address not verified, amount exceeds limit, or high-risk category.

resolution.en: Prompt consumer to select prepaid payment method. Display codEligibilityReason.

title.id: Milestone pembayaran gagal atau jatuh tempo
title.en: Payment schedule milestone failed or overdue

description.en: A scheduled payment milestone (down-payment, balance, etc.) failed to collect or is past dueAt + graceDays. Contract cannot progress until milestone is resolved.

resolution.en: Retry collection via /init with fresh payment method, or cancel with appropriate reason.

title.en: Invalid GPS coordinate format

description.en: GPS coordinates must be in lat,lon format with minimum 4 decimal places. Longitude-first (GeoJSON) is not accepted in context.location.gps.

resolution.en: Format as '-6.261000,106.815000' (lat,lon). Minimum 4 decimal places. Do not swap longitude and latitude.

title.en: Performance record not found

description.en: The performanceId in a status or track request does not correspond to a known performance record for this contract.

resolution.en: Use performanceId from on_confirm. Multiple performance records may exist (main delivery + return). Reference the correct one.

title.en: Invalid performance state transition

description.en: The BPP attempted to transition the performance to a state that is not permitted from the current state per the performance-states state machine.

resolution.en: Check the allowed transitions in schema/extensions/trade/performance-states/v1/states.yaml. Cannot skip states or go backwards.

title.id: Pembatalan tidak diizinkan setelah status ini
title.en: Cancellation not allowed after current state

description.en: Buyer attempted to cancel after the performance state has passed the cancellation window declared in the offer's policies.cancellation.policyRef.

resolution.en: Enforce cancellation window in BAP UI. Check cancellationFeeApplicableStates — if current state is in this list, fee applies.

title.en: Cancellation reason not accepted by seller

description.en: The cancellation reason code sent is not in the seller's declared policies.cancellation.allowedReasons list.

resolution.en: Only send cancellation reasons that are in the offer's policies.cancellation.allowedReasons. Display these reasons to consumer in the cancellation flow.

title.en: SLA breach — penalty applied

description.en: BPP breached declared SLA. Penalty deduction applied at reconcile time per ION network penalty schedule.

resolution.en: BPP may dispute via raise channel if breach attribution is incorrect.

title.en: Action not permitted by declared policy

description.en: Request attempted an action outside the bounds of the declared policy IRI. Examples: cancelling past cancellationWindowCloses state, returning outside returnWindowDays (from policies.returns.policyRef IRI), requesting refund when refundAfterQC=false before QC. ION resolves the policy IRI and applies the terms document as enforcement.

resolution.en: Read the policy terms document for the declared IRI. Respect the window/reason/condition constraints it specifies.

title.en: SLA violated - auto escalation triggered

description.en: Grievance SLA policy's firstResponseSla or resolutionSla was breached. ION Central has auto-escalated to the next level in the policy's escalationLevels and queued the linked penalty policy for application at reconcile time.

resolution.en: Respond to tickets within declared firstResponseSla. SLA breaches compound - repeat offenders face harsher penalties.

title.en: Age verification failed at delivery

description.en: Delivery agent could not verify buyer age for age-restricted item. Reasons include buyer underage, refused to show ID, no valid ID, or biometric API failure. Delivery fails; RTO initiates.

resolution.en: Initiate RTO flow. Buyer may be restricted from future purchases of this category per platform policy.

title.en: Data residency violation

description.en: A BAP or BPP processing foreign infrastructure attempted to transact a resource with dataResidency=DOMESTIC_ONLY. Transaction refused. Required for pharmacy, health data, financial services under UU 27/2022.

resolution.en: BAP must confirm domestic-only data processing before attempting these transactions; otherwise filter such resources from discovery.

title.en: Reconciliation amount mismatch

description.en: The amount declared by BAP in /reconcile does not match the amount expected by BPP based on the confirmed contract quote.

resolution.en: Compare amounts against the confirmed contract quote (locked at on_confirm). If mismatch is due to adjustments, ensure all adjustments are declared in reconAttributes.adjustments[] with references.

title.en: Payment rail not supported

description.en: The paymentRail declared in the settlement is not in the ION-supported payment rails list.

resolution.en: Use only payment rails declared in ion.yaml x-ion-settlement.allowedPaymentRails.

title.en: Penalty settlement applied

description.en: A penalty policy was triggered during the contract lifecycle and has been applied to reconcile. Not an error per se - informational code so BAP and BPP systems can surface the deduction and its reason to operators. Deduction amount and breakdown are in reconcile.amounts.slaPenaltyDeduction and reconcile.amounts.slaPenaltyBreakdown.

resolution.en: Penalized party may dispute via raise channel within 7 days. Dispute goes to marketplace mediation first then BPSK/BANI per disputePolicy.

title.en: Batch reconcile contract detail mismatch

description.en: In a batch reconcile, the sum of contractDetails amounts does not match the top-level baseContractAmount, or contractIds does not align with contractDetails entries.

resolution.en: Recompute contractDetails; ensure every contractId has a detail entry and sums reconcile.

title.en: Parent reconId not found for adjustment

description.en: An adjustment reconcile references a parentReconId that does not exist in the registry or is outside the valid adjustment window.

resolution.en: Verify parentReconId. If adjustment window has expired, raise a dispute via raise channel instead.

title.en: Tax withholding evidence missing

description.en: Reconcile declares taxWithholdings but the corresponding remittance reference (NTPN) or buktiPotongUrl is missing. Required for audit compliance under Indonesian tax law.

resolution.en: Include remittanceRef and buktiPotongUrl for each taxWithholding entry.

title.en: Clawback attempted past adjustment window

description.en: Adjustment of type CLAWBACK attempted more than 90 days after the parent reconcile. Adjustment window closed.

resolution.en: Raise formal dispute via raise channel with type=SETTLEMENT_DISPUTE instead.

title.id: NIB tidak terdaftar atau tidak aktif
title.en: NIB not registered or inactive

description.en: The NIB declared by the BPP is not found in the OSS registry or has been deactivated.

resolution.en: Verify NIB status at oss.go.id. Update nibRegistered to false if NIB is inactive. ION Central validates NIB at catalog publish time.

title.id: Mata uang harus IDR untuk transaksi domestik
title.en: Currency must be IDR for domestic transactions

description.en: The currency field is not IDR. All domestic ION Trade transactions must use IDR.

resolution.en: Set all price.currency and consideration.currency fields to IDR. Cross-border (cross-border pattern) has a separate currency handling specification.

title.en: Required field missing

description.en: A required field declared in the schema's required[] array is absent from the payload.

resolution.en: Check the attributes.yaml for the relevant schema pack. Fields listed in required[] must always be present. Conditional requirements are enforced via JSON Schema if/then/else blocks.

title.en: Invalid NPWP format

description.en: NPWP must be exactly 16 digits (new format post-2024). Old 15-digit format is not accepted.

resolution.en: Use the 16-digit NPWP format as per PMK 136/2023. Do not include dots or dashes.

title.en: Bahasa Indonesia 'id' field required in localised text

description.en: A LocalisedText object is missing the mandatory 'id' (Bahasa Indonesia) key. ION network policy requires all catalog content to have Bahasa Indonesia text.

resolution.en: Always include 'id' key in all LocalisedText objects with Bahasa Indonesia content. English 'en' is also required for cross-border pattern.

title.en: ION internal error

description.en: An unexpected error occurred within ION infrastructure. This is not a caller error.

resolution.en: Retry with exponential backoff. If persists beyond 5 minutes, raise an ION-7xxx network ticket.

title.en: BPP callback timeout

description.en: The BAP did not receive an on_ callback within the expected TTL window. BPP may have failed to respond.

resolution.en: For /on_confirm timeout: initiate force-cancel flow as per flows/trade/variants/during-transaction/v1. Log incident and consider raising an ION-7xxx ticket if BPP is persistently unresponsive.

title.en: Resource missing required images

resolution.en: Provide at least one valid HTTPS image URL in images[]. First image is the primary thumbnail.

title.id: Skor kredit di bawah ambang batas minimum
title.en: Credit score below minimum threshold

description.en: The borrower's credit score from the credit bureau (SLIK) falls below the minimum threshold required by the lender's credit policy for the requested loan product.

resolution.en: Borrower must improve credit score before reapplying. Lender may offer alternative products with higher rates for lower credit scores. Minimum score threshold is declared in offerAttributes.creditPolicy.minCreditScore.

title.en: Credit bureau data unavailable

description.en: The SLIK/BI Checking credit bureau service is temporarily unavailable or returned an inconclusive response during credit assessment.

resolution.en: Retry the request after a brief delay. If the issue persists, contact ION network operations. BPP must not block assessment indefinitely; use cached data with a staleness flag if within the acceptable staleness window declared in offerAttributes.creditPolicy.slikCacheTtl.

title.en: Credit limit exceeded

description.en: The requested loan amount exceeds the borrower's available credit limit as determined by the lender's credit assessment or pre-approved credit limit.

resolution.en: Reduce the requested loan amount to within the available credit limit. The available limit is returned in on_select.offerAttributes.creditLimit.available.

title.en: Income verification failed

description.en: The borrower's declared income could not be verified against available data sources (e-slip, bank statement, tax return) or falls below the minimum income requirement for the loan product.

resolution.en: Submit verifiable income documents. Accepted document types are declared in offerAttributes.requiredDocuments. Ensure document figures match the declared income amount in participantAttributes.monthlyIncome.

title.id: Rasio utang terhadap pendapatan melebihi batas
title.en: Debt-to-income ratio exceeded

description.en: The borrower's total monthly debt obligations including the requested loan installment exceed the maximum debt-to-income (DTI) ratio allowed by OJK regulation (typically 50–70% of gross income depending on product category).

resolution.en: Borrower must reduce existing debt or request a lower loan amount resulting in a smaller monthly installment. DTI is computed as (total monthly obligations / gross monthly income) × 100. Maximum DTI is declared in offerAttributes.creditPolicy.maxDti.

title.id: KYC peminjam kedaluwarsa atau tidak disetujui
title.en: Borrower KYC expired or not approved

description.en: The borrower's KYC status is not APPROVED or the kycExpiry date has passed. All finance transactions require valid KYC with kycStatus APPROVED and kycExpiry in the future.

resolution.en: Borrower must complete or renew KYC through the BAP's identity verification flow before initiating new finance transactions. New transactions are blocked until kycStatus returns to APPROVED.

title.en: KYC identity mismatch

description.en: The identity data submitted (NIK, full name, date of birth) does not match the data on record in Dukcapil or the previously verified KYC profile stored by the lender.

resolution.en: Verify that NIK, full name, and date of birth exactly match Dukcapil records. If personal data has officially changed, submit an identity update supported by Dukcapil documents before re-initiating.

title.en: Collateral valuation insufficient

description.en: The appraised value of the declared collateral does not meet the minimum loan-to-value (LTV) ratio required for the secured loan product.

resolution.en: Provide additional collateral or reduce the requested loan amount so that loanAmount ≤ (appraisedValue × maxLTV). Accepted LTV ceiling is declared in offerAttributes.collateralPolicy.maxLtv.

title.id: Agunan sudah dijaminkan pada fasilitas lain
title.en: Collateral already encumbered by another facility

description.en: The collateral asset declared (property, vehicle, or other asset) is already registered as collateral for another active loan and cannot be pledged again until the prior lien or fiducia registration is released.

resolution.en: Release the prior encumbrance (SKMHT/APHT/AHT fiducia) before pledging the asset again, or provide alternative unencumbered collateral. Reference existing lien in contractAttributes.collateral.existingLienRef.

title.id: Rekening pencairan tidak valid atau belum terverifikasi
title.en: Disbursement account invalid or unverified

description.en: The bank account declared for loan disbursement failed account verification (penny-drop or name-match) or belongs to a third party not authorized to receive disbursement on behalf of the borrower.

resolution.en: Ensure settlementAttributes.disbursementAccount.accountNumber and accountName pass penny-drop verification and match the borrower's registered identity. Third-party accounts require explicit power-of-attorney documentation.

title.en: Daily disbursement limit exceeded

description.en: The disbursement amount exceeds the daily transaction limit set by the payment gateway or applicable OJK regulations for the lender's disbursement rail.

resolution.en: Split disbursement across multiple calendar days or use an alternative payment rail with a higher daily limit. Daily limits per rail are declared in offerAttributes.disbursementPolicy.dailyLimit.

title.id: Peminjam tercatat dalam SLIK dengan kolektibilitas buruk
title.en: Borrower has adverse SLIK collectability record

description.en: The borrower has an active adverse record in SLIK (Sistem Layanan Informasi Keuangan) with a collectability rating of 4 (doubtful) or 5 (bad debt), indicating material credit risk.

resolution.en: Borrower must settle all delinquent obligations and submit an SLIK data correction request to OJK. New credit facilities are blocked until collectability rating improves to 1 (current) or 2 (special mention).

title.id: Suku bunga melebihi batas maksimum OJK
title.en: Interest rate exceeds OJK regulatory cap

description.en: The declared annual percentage rate (APR) or flat interest rate for the loan product exceeds the maximum rate cap set by OJK for the applicable loan category (KTA, KPR, KKPE, or UMKM).

resolution.en: Revise offerAttributes.interestRate to comply with the OJK rate cap for the product category. Current OJK rate caps are declared in policies/FIN-02/interest-rate-cap/v1 and must be refreshed each quarter.

title.id: Tenor pinjaman melebihi maksimum yang diizinkan
title.en: Loan tenure exceeds maximum allowed

description.en: The requested loan tenure in months exceeds the maximum tenure permitted by the loan product configuration or OJK regulation for the product category. Mortgage products also apply a borrower-age-at-maturity constraint.

resolution.en: Reduce contractAttributes.tenureMonths to within offerAttributes.maxTenureMonths. For KPR products, also verify that borrower age at loan maturity does not exceed offerAttributes.maxBorrowerAgeAtMaturity (typically 65 years).

title.en: Duplicate loan application detected

description.en: A loan application with the same borrower NIK, product ID, and approximate loan amount is already active (pending assessment, approved, or disbursed) within the deduplication window.

resolution.en: Check the status of the existing application via /status before submitting a new one. If the prior application must be withdrawn, cancel it via /cancel first. The deduplication window duration is configurable per lender in offerAttributes.applicationPolicy.dedupWindowHours.

title.id: KYC penjamin gagal atau tidak lengkap
title.en: Guarantor KYC failed or incomplete

description.en: The loan product requires a guarantor and the declared guarantor's KYC status is not APPROVED, or the guarantor's identity documents are missing or could not be verified against Dukcapil.

resolution.en: Guarantor must independently complete KYC before being added to a loan application. The verified guarantor participantId must be submitted in contractAttributes.guarantorId once KYC returns APPROVED.

title.en: Repayment overdue — account delinquent

description.en: The loan account has one or more overdue installment payments past the due date. New top-up loans and credit facility increases are blocked until all outstanding dues are settled.

resolution.en: Borrower must settle all overdue installments. Current overdue amount and due date are in performanceAttributes.overdueAmount and performanceAttributes.oldestDueDateOverdue. After settlement, delinquencyStatus must return to CURRENT before new facilities are processed.

title.en: Repayment amount does not match scheduled installment

description.en: The repayment amount submitted does not match the scheduled installment amount in the amortization schedule. Partial payments below the minimum due are rejected unless the lender's policy explicitly permits partial settlement.

resolution.en: Submit the exact amount declared in performanceAttributes.schedule[n].amountDue, or the full outstanding principal for early settlement. For hardship arrangements, request a payment plan modification via /update with updateType RESTRUCTURE.

title.id: Produk keuangan tidak tersedia di wilayah peminjam
title.en: Loan product not available in borrower's region

description.en: The lender's OJK/POJK license does not cover the borrower's registered domicile province or city. Cross-region lending is restricted to the lender's licensed geographic coverage area.

resolution.en: BAP must filter loan products by borrower domicile against offerAttributes.coverageArea before presenting options to the borrower. Lender must declare accurate provincial coverage in publish_catalog using resourceAttributes.borrowerCriteria.serviceRegions.

title.en: Credit utilization ratio too high

description.en: The borrower's current credit utilization across all active revolving facilities exceeds the lender's threshold, indicating over-leveraging risk that conflicts with prudent lending standards.

resolution.en: Borrower must reduce outstanding balances on revolving credit facilities before applying. Utilization ratio is computed as (total utilized revolving credit / total revolving credit limit) × 100. Maximum acceptable ratio is declared in offerAttributes.creditPolicy.maxCreditUtilization.
